society.skycraft.say.region.maormer_isle: Behind a warm curtain of eternal sea-mist, the Pyandonean fleet anchorage harbours scale-hulled privateers and storm-callers of Immortal Orgnum.
society.skycraft.say.maormer_isles.1: The Maormer Isles of Pyandonea rise out of a perpetual warm sea-fog south of Summerset: steep volcanic jungle peaks, giant kelp lagoons, and fleet harbours built from sea-serpent bone and translucent kelpsail.
society.skycraft.say.maormer_isles.2: Foreign ships from Tamriel may moor only at the outer Pyandonean Fleet Anchorage under a privateer truce-token to trade for black pearls and serpent-scale mail;.
society.skycraft.say.maormer_isles.3: inland past Mistveil Village stands the Sanctum of the Coiled King, where Maormer storm-callers harness lightning spires and breed sea serpents for the next armada against Auridon.
society.skycraft.say.maormer_isles.4: Here in the Maormer Isles, the land is shaped by steep jungle peaks ringed by barrier reefs and serpent trenches, and every traveler learns to read the ground.
society.skycraft.say.maormer_isles.5: Watch the sky when eternal tropical fog and sudden lightning squalls sets in across the Maormer Isles—it changes the roads in an hour.
society.skycraft.say.maormer_isles.6: Our people draw their living along deep sheltered fleet basins, where water and road meet.
society.skycraft.say.maormer_isles.7: Don't stray far into giant kelp fronds, bioluminescent ferns, and sea serpents after dusk unless you carry steel and a steady lantern.
society.skycraft.say.maormer_isles.8: The markets of the Maormer Isles turn on serpent-scale mail, pearls, and truce safe-conducts, and every caravan counts the weight twice.
society.skycraft.say.maormer_isles.9: From kelpsail docks on the coastal terrace and Mistveil Village on the ridge, the watch-horns carry clear across steep jungle peaks ringed by barrier reefs and serpent trenches.
society.skycraft.say.maormer_isles.10: Ask anyone in the Maormer Isles who holds the reins and they'll point you to Maormer storm-mages and foreign privateers.
society.skycraft.say.maormer_isles.11: Even in hard seasons, folk here keep the rites of worship of the undying wizard-king and his Coffer.
society.skycraft.say.maormer_isles.12: Tempers run sharp over a mutinous fleet-lord charging a storm-spire to strike Vulkhel Guard whenever the tax-scribes and patrols ride through the Maormer Isles.
society.skycraft.say.maormer_isles.13: Give a wide berth to rising tidal chambers and lightning-rod sea grottoes—scavengers who go in rarely bring their packs back out.
society.skycraft.say.maormer_isles.14: The elders still tell of the War of the Isle and the storm that shattered Orgnum's fleet, written into the stones of the Maormer Isles.
society.skycraft.say.maormer_isles.15: Between steep jungle peaks ringed by barrier reefs and serpent trenches and deep sheltered fleet basins, there's no mistaking the borders of the Maormer Isles.
